## Pointer

The raw thing this points at: an issue number, a DECISIONS.md entry, a SPEC.md

-->

## Which kind of change is this?

- [ ] **Mechanical** — typo, formatting, tooling, example fix. Needs no prior decision.
- [ ] **Substantive** — changes what the spec means or requires. Points at an existing
      decision in `DECISIONS.md`, or expects the argument to happen before merge.

<!--
If substantive and there is no decision yet, that's fine — say so. The
discussion is the work. It happens in public and gets mirrored to DECISIONS.md;
a PR is not where a decision gets made quietly.
-->

## Checklist

- [ ] Every commit is signed off — `git commit -s` — per the DCO
      ([CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md)). I have the right to submit this work
      and I license it under Apache-2.0.
- [ ] My sign-off identity traces to a responsible operator. If I am an agent,
      a person or organization answers for this contribution.
- [ ] No credentials, keys, tokens, sign-in links, private URLs, or personal
      data — in code, examples, tests, commit messages, or this description.
- [ ] No platform code, submodules, or shared configuration from any other
      project. (D-005 — the bright line. This repository stays
      platform-optional.)
- [ ] No invisible or non-rendering characters used to hide meaning — Unicode
      Tags block (U+E0000–U+E007F), zero-width space, soft hyphen, homoglyph
      substitution. If a diff of mine contains any legitimately, I have said so
      above. (SECURITY.md)
- [ ] If this grows the spec's surface area, I have argued why. Contributions
      that shrink it get read first.
